projectList.title: De Nouveau
projectList.role: Product Design / Full Stack Development / CMS Architecture / Deployment
projectList.summary: Portfolio website for an architecture studio, built around project showcases, a headless CMS, and an efficient media management system.
projectList.seoTitle: De Nouveau architecture portfolio website | Full Stack CMS project
projectList.seoDescription: Case study for De Nouveau, an architecture portfolio website built with Next.js, Payload CMS, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare R2 and Vercel to publish projects, media and SEO content.
description: Designed and developed a premium portfolio website for an architecture studio, featuring a minimalist editorial aesthetic focused on showcasing architectural projects.
Implemented a headless CMS using Payload CMS, enabling the client to manage pages, projects, categories, images, videos, and SEO metadata through a dedicated administration interface.

Built a full-stack architecture using Next.js, PostgreSQL via Neon, Cloudflare R2 media storage through an S3-compatible setup, Vercel deployment, and automatic cache revalidation after content updates.
Created reusable project layouts — default, editorial, gallery focused, and minimal — allowing each project to be presented according to its visual or narrative requirements.
Configured a CI workflow with GitHub Actions to automatically run linting, formatting checks, tests, and production builds before deployment.
The resulting editorial workflow gives the studio direct control over its content and media while keeping each project presentation consistent.

detailSections.title: Project context
detailSections.body: De Nouveau needed a refined architecture portfolio website that could present projects with strong visual direction while remaining easy to update without developer intervention.

detailSections.title: Technical approach
detailSections.body: The project combines a Next.js frontend, a Payload CMS administration layer, PostgreSQL data storage, Cloudflare R2 media hosting and Vercel deployment to support structured content and reliable publishing.

detailSections.title: SEO and maintainability
detailSections.body: The CMS was designed to manage project pages, images, categories and SEO metadata, making the website easier to maintain and giving each architecture project its own crawlable content surface.

projectList.title: Reusable Executive Portfolio SPA
projectList.summary: Reusable React and TypeScript CV portfolio for an executive in a car insurance company.
projectList.seoTitle: Reusable executive portfolio SPA | React TypeScript case study
projectList.seoDescription: Case study for a reusable executive portfolio single page application built with React, TypeScript, React Router, Tailwind CSS and component-driven content integration.
description: Designed a reusable Single Page Application for integration into an existing client application, while respecting its technical stack and integration constraints.
The objective was to build a content-driven portfolio without hardcoded data, combining a minimalist editorial design, smooth animations, a responsive layout, and light and dark themes.
Implemented the portfolio with React, TypeScript and React Router, including client-side routes and a dedicated 404 page.
The result is a reusable component whose content and presentation can be adapted to different executive profiles without rebuilding the interface.

detailSections.title: Project context
detailSections.body: The client needed a reusable executive profile and portfolio experience that could be integrated inside an existing application without hardcoded content.

detailSections.title: Frontend implementation
detailSections.body: The interface was built with React, TypeScript, React Router and Tailwind CSS, with reusable UI patterns, responsive layouts, animated transitions and light and dark theme support.

detailSections.title: Content structure
detailSections.body: The component was designed around structured content so the profile, experience, routes and portfolio sections could evolve without requiring layout-level changes.

projectList.title: Ribelmais Buch
projectList.summary: WordPress and Shopify e-commerce website dedicated to the publication, launch, and online sale of a book.
projectList.seoTitle: Ribelmais Buch e-commerce website | WordPress Shopify project
projectList.seoDescription: Case study for Ribelmais Buch, a responsive WordPress and Shopify website created for a Swiss book launch, online sales, editorial presentation and product discovery.
description: Design and development of a website for a Swiss client to coincide with the launch of their book, including Shopify integration for online management and sales.
The goal was to build a precise e-commerce website with the minimalist design requested by the client.
Combined WordPress for editorial content with Shopify for product and order management, resulting in a clear path from discovering the book to purchasing it online.

detailSections.title: Project context
detailSections.body: Ribelmais Buch required a clear product website to support the publication of a book, present the project and guide visitors toward online purchase.

detailSections.title: Implementation
detailSections.body: The website combines a WordPress content foundation with Shopify integration for sales management, allowing editorial content and commerce flows to work together.

detailSections.title: User experience
detailSections.body: The design keeps the interface minimal and direct, with responsive layouts, readable product information and a focused path from discovery to purchase.
